title: Dimglass Coast - Lanterns Along the Tide (SNES register)
_note: Signature first-route theme, re-voiced into the lush SNES register for the player's first taste of the open road. Same tune/identity as the gbc anchor (the bounced-Vesper lead + rocking-wave bass unchanged note-for-note) but the chip band opens up: a warm STRINGS pad carrying real chords (G-C-D-Em) for sea-air body, the buoy arp re-voiced as a PLUCK harp, and a sparse high BELL leaning the Tide+Light signature (bell-buoys passing in the dark). snes era => warm reverb 0.18 + chord stacking. 120 BPM, 4/4, G major (relative-major neighbour to Tinderwick's C/Am). 16-bar walking loop.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: UNCHANGED. Bounced Vesper: D4->G4->A4 lifts on a perky figure, B4->A4->G4 settles. Hook front-loaded bars 1-2. Last bar lands on D4 (dom) leading back to the G downbeat.
